parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The ID of the live interactive application to query.

parameters.name: DataCenter
parameters.description: The data center. This value must be the same as the data center specified in [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~). Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The group ID of the group to query.

parameters.name: NextPageToken
parameters.description: The start position of the query page. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is returned by default.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of users to display per page. Valid values: **10 to 50**.

parameters.name: SortType
parameters.description:
The sort order. Users are sorted by the time they joined the group. Valid values:

- 1: ascending order.

- 2: descending order.
